task.description:
Run the test suite for API-01 and produce a structured test report.

Commands to run:
  zig build test

Capture and report:
- Pass/fail for each test case in tests/unit/api_conventions_test.zig
- Overall pass/fail
- Any error messages for failing tests

Write the test report to: tests/reports/WF02-api01-20260522-test-report.json

Report format:
{
  "run_id": "WF02-api01-20260522",
  "requirement_ids": ["API-01"],
  "ran_at": "<ISO8601>",
  "command": "zig build test",
  "overall": "PASS" | "FAIL",
  "tests": [
    { "name": "<test name>", "result": "PASS" | "FAIL", "error": null | "<message>" }
  ],
  "issues": []
}
